notes: WArmy 0.4.26 — Harness-squared borrowing round (R231): an evidence-based audit of the HANDOFF-HARNESS2 adoption plan plus a fully offline experiment pipeline. (A) The plan was re-verified line by line against the real codebase: every math formula (Bonferroni U=1-0.05^(1/n), paired sign-test p, Hoeffding sample bound) was recomputed and every claimed integration point was located by symbol/line; ten concrete gaps (E1-E10) were found and written into a new section 23 of the plan — missing provider exit points (openai cancel / ollama admin fetches), the activeEventsIn recall path, lock-facility attribution, the absence of any pre-existing duplicate-key-rejecting JSON parser, the ManifestTreatment arms gap, empty root lint/test scripts, gate-registration convention, pinyin naming, the WARMY_PROBE hook, and verify-entry relationships. (B) Answer to the A/B question: the plan DOES contain an A/B branch (section 11 improvement seven); the shipped product had none before; this round lands a complete OFFLINE A/B pipeline, and a real-model pilot is deferred pending explicit approval. (C) Offline engineering landed across five packages: contracts gained the experiment type surface (manifest/run/budget/evidence/procedure lifecycle); app-shell gained harness-experiment.ts (immutable identity + deterministic config hash, append-only event stream with single-writer lock + replay + tail-fragment isolation, reservation-conserving budget ledger with idempotent per-dimension settlement and no clamping on overrun, evidence vault with capacity bound + three views + byteRange checks, strict duplicate-key-rejecting JSON parser, BigInt fixed-point acceptance oracle, four safe tools with realpath checks) and harness-host.ts (frozen manifest bound to an approval event, randomized interleaved serial A/B scheduling, keep_baseline as a legal no-gain outcome, unknown-blocks decision policy, and an offline fake provider); providers gained a send-permission observer wired into every fetch exit (openai/anthropic/ollama chat + stream + ladder) so budget-exhaustion errors are never retried; knowledge-base gained procedure-experience isolation (a single admission predicate re-exported everywhere, authorized-only recall, observed->provisional->validated lifecycle where validated requires a host-trusted basis). No UI surface changed and no real model is called. Verified by an 85-assertion offline contract gate (identity/state/ledger/persistence/tool-permission/evidence/oracle/A-B end-to-end/experience-lifecycle/normal-call-zero-impact) plus a 20-assertion static suite, and the scoped runner: 19 gates x 3 consecutive clean rounds covering exactly the changed surfaces plus R224-R230 contract regressions.
